vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security PRs skip the schedule and the release-age wait (Renovate forces minimumReleaseAge: null), so never automerge them. addLabels keeps the top-level "dependencies" label; labels would replace it.

customManagers.description: The Trivy scanner image is pinned by tag and digest in a workflow env var, which the github-actions manager does not read.

packageRules.description: Update package.json ranges alongside bun.lock, including releases already inside the current range.

Every patch arrives in one weekly PR (renovate/patch-all). Renovate merges it itself once every check on it is green; repository auto-merge is off, so platformAutomerge stays false. The docker-publish workflow typechecks, tests and builds and smoke-tests the image on every PR that touches package.json, bun.lock, docker/** or the workflows, which covers every file Renovate updates here.
0.x patches can break, so they get their own weekly PR (renovate/patch-all-0.x) merged by a person; one 0.x patch cannot hold the automerged patch PR.
Every minor update arrives in one weekly PR, merged by a person.
Require dashboard approval before opening breaking major upgrade PRs.
Routine action bumps and digest pins go in one weekly PR, merged by a person: PR CI runs only some of the actions release.yml and the publish job use.
Keep action patches and minors in that one PR.
Image digest refreshes for the same tag go in one weekly PR, merged by a person.
static-ffmpeg tags carry a numeric build revision (9.0.2-1); treat it as a build number so rebuilds and new upstream patches are both proposed.

docker/resolve-n8n-base.sh resolves n8nio/n8n:stable to a digest on every build and the hourly schedule rebuilds when it moves, so the Dockerfile ARG default stays a floating tag. docker-compose.yml uses this repository's own published latest image.
